title: Cathedral
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Paladin
lines.text: Vile monsters! You dare defile this hallowed ground?!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Well, we’re not getting in through the front. Even if we kill all of the guards, they’ll alert everyone else to our presence.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: There might be a side entrance. Let’s take a look around.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I told you this would happen. Let’s hope you were right about there being a side entrance.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Why do these paladins hate us so much? Is it solely because we are undead?

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: That's reason enough, in their eyes. But in truth, they blame us for the fall of Lordaeron.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Perhaps there are some who still pursue justice, whatever that means. But most want only revenge.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: We're in. Now to eliminate the Silver Hand.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: It's the Light! Kill the priests, quickly!
